test_scope: Real SQLite/filesystem/ASGI/owner middleware, with generative inference explicitly doubled; no new real-provider inference claim.
behaviors: Explicit repository is part of modern admission identity; an operation key cannot retarget it.
Duplicate admission only reads its receipt, including when still queued and after catalog changes.
Original automatic selection survives owner restart and explicit retry.
Changed registration or replaced observed directory identity prevents a start.
Historical queued receipt stays unbound and its inference history unknown.
Capacity returns the admitted queued request without a worker.
Shutdown during threaded validation cannot publish a late worker.
Owner start retry rejects repository/request additions, cross-project scope and changed retry intent.
Retry rechecks supported task type and does not expand capabilities.
No dispatch, unknown start and acknowledged start remain distinct; private diagnostics are redacted.

independent_analysis.mode: read-only source inspection; no model inference or tests

limits: Binding is not cross-database workspace ownership or verified deployment/restore generation.
Directory identity checks do not freeze content or eliminate filesystem check/use races.
Legacy task metadata writers still need versioning/fencing; a context version alone does not freeze all task fields.
Command/tool legacy consumers and other eleven UI routes remain pending.
